title: Allow one additional read-only call for bounded architectural discovery
hypothesis: Increasing only the core read-only batch allowance from five to six lets Sol inspect a small layered codebase and its tests in one round, reducing model turns or latency without increasing mutation concurrency, broad exploration, or correctness failures.
falsified_if: The treatment loses any deterministic pass, increases mean model calls or latency on the multi-file scenario, triggers unnecessary tools on the simple prompt, or weakens existing-codebase verification and scope control.
deterministic_outcomes: multi-file behavior, architecture, scope, and verification all pass
existing-codebase behavior, scope, and verification all pass
simple prompt remains one model call with zero tools
efficiency_outcomes: core batch caps and tool calls
decision_rule: Adopt six only if every treatment run passes, the simple prompt remains one model call with zero tools, existing-codebase scope and verification remain intact, and the multi-file treatment reduces mean model calls or latency without worsening the other by more than ten percent. Otherwise retain five.
